postings.description:

We are looking for bright graduates with a passion for software and a curiosity for how things work and how technology can help us solve problems.    

You will join our embedded software team and contribute to the development of innovative technologies for healthcare devices.

Candidates can start between May–October 2027.

Each project we undertake is different, and at the cutting edge of technology. This means we can't talk about much of our ongoing work, but here are some examples of completed projects that we are excited to share:

- An emergency-use ventilator, developed in just over six weeks in response to the government’s Ventilator Challenge  

- A neurostimulation device allowing treatment to improve, or even restore, someone’s ability to walk  

- An autoinjector capable of delivering a wide range of drugs, while being intuitive to use and beautiful to look at

From day one, you’ll be part of our multidisciplinary medical development team, tackling real technical problems while receiving guidance and training from experienced engineers. - Collaborate with a multidisciplinary and supportive team, gaining exposure to systems involving electronics, optics, fluidics, robotics, and user-interface components.

- Work with industry best practices such as continuous integration, automated testing and analysis, and model-based systems engineering.

What You Can Bring

Application requirements

To apply for this role you must:

- Be currently completing or have recent completed a degree in a relevant field such as Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Physics.

- Contributing to open-source software

- Unit testing or other verification techniques

- Experience developing embedded software

- Knowledge of electronics and controlling peripherals using interfaces such as UART/I2C/SPI

Knowledge of biology or medical subjects is not a requirement, though you should be enthusiastic about applying your technical skills to this field of application.

Overview

We're looking for an Agentic Systems Engineer, to work on systems that haven't existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren't chatbots waiting for questions. They're proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines.

You'll work in two directions at once. Internally, you'll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you'll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace.

There's no single technology stack. You'll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Looking for part-time work? We're open to candidates seeking a 4-day working week as well as those looking for full-time hours.

The role 

At Cambridge Consultants, we help our clients develop breakthrough technologies across industries including Energy and Industrial, Defence and Security, Consumer, Telecoms, Healthcare and Biotechnology, and many others. 

As an Electronics Engineer with a focus on printed circuit board (PCB) design, you will work within multidisciplinary project teams to solve interesting technical problems for clients ranging from start-ups to global organisations and government bodies. You'll take ownership of electronics elements of projects, contributing both broad electronics know-how and detailed design of circuits and circuit boards.

We're less concerned with experience of specific software packages than with a keen interest in solving electronics problems. However, candidates may have experience with tools such as Altium or KiCAD for PCB design, LTSpice or other circuit simulation tools, or HyperLynx for signal integrity simulation, and we'd welcome exposure to any of these areas. 

This role is well suited to engineers who enjoy tackling unfamiliar problems, working closely with clients and multidisciplinary teams, and helping to deliver robust, real-world solutions. As your career develops, you'll have opportunities to deepen your technical expertise, broaden your responsibilities, and contribute to the growth of new client opportunities. 

What will you be doing? 

Some interesting electronics projects that we’ve previously solved include: 

- Collaborating with LEGO to develop LEGO® SMART Play™  

- Design of a low-power, high-performance smart wearable for Accesso integrating multiple radios 

- Developing a novel air-interface and bespoke communication systems for the Ocado Smart Platform controlling hundreds of robots in grocery distribution centres 

- Developing the Iridium Extreme satellite phone, the first truly-global ‘push-to-talk’ mobile communications system  

- Next-generation Explosive Ordnance Disposal for the British Army 

- High altitude 5G phased array for targeted cellular coverage, with internal data-rates of over 10 Tbps

Every project we undertake is different. We are typically creating something new rather than refining an existing solution, so you can expect a steady stream of technically diverse and intellectually stimulating work. 

You'll also have access to our extensive in-house facilities, which support every stage of hardware development engineering. These include: 

- Prototype PCB manufacturing facilities, including SMT pick-and-place, vapour-phase reflow and X-ray inspection 

- EMC emissions test facility 

- 8.5GHz 360° antenna test facility

We are looking for engineers with a genuine interest in electronics, at least a brief period of commercial experience, and a passion for developing innovative technology. This is a client-facing role, so good communication skills, curiosity, and the ability to work effectively in a team is required. 

Essential technical requirements: 

- Strong academic background with an electronics-related undergraduate degree 

- Solid understanding of the fundamentals of electronic circuit design 

- Some knowledge of printed circuit board (PCB) design 

Engineers who thrive in this role are comfortable taking ownership of technical work, learning quickly when faced with new situations, and applying sound engineering judgement to deliver robust solutions in a client-focused environment.

You must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC) level security clearance (https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant). You’ll work at Cambridge Consultants as a salaried employee for approximately 10 months between finishing school and starting at university, and join a team aligned to your technical interests and career aspirations. postings.description:
Overview 

Cambridge Consultants is seeking an experienced business development professional to drive growth of our MedTech business across Asia Pacific. Cambridge Consultants has established healthcare businesses in North America, Europe and Japan, and is now looking to build a pipeline of new client relationships across the broader Asia-Pacific region. 

Working closely with our global Healthcare team and business development colleagues in Japan and Singapore, you will identify, develop and secure high-value opportunities with healthcare and MedTech organisations across the region. This is a hands-on commercial role focused on generating and winning new business while providing market insight that informs the evolution of the Healthcare business. 

You will be identifying the right conversations, engaging senior stakeholders at organisations with real budget — whether well-funded start-ups or multinationals — across our drug delivery, diagnostics and monitoring, and complex medical device sectors, and working with our technical teams to shape and win proposals. 

The successful candidate will bring a genuine, senior network among healthcare and MedTech decision-makers in the region, credibility to engage confidently at executive level, and a willingness to roll up their sleeves and remain involved throughout the entire cycle from business development until successful project completion. 

What you'll be doing

The role requires strong commercial instincts and confidence selling large opportunities. You will engage senior decision-makers, build trusted client relationships, shape compelling propositions and secure complex innovation, product development and technology consulting programmes. Given our deep tech focus, these conversations have to start early, well before a full requirement is defined. 

Business Development: 

- Grow MedTech business across APAC, particularly outside Japan. 

- Build relationships with senior executives and decision-makers. 

- Lead opportunities from initial engagement through contract award. 

- Maintain a robust pipeline and deliver growth objectives. 

Strategic Contribution: 

- Provide customer, market and competitive insights. 

- Identify emerging trends and opportunities. 

Collaboration: 

- Partner with healthcare colleagues globally. 

- Work collaboratively with the business development team in Japan to coordinate client engagement and share market intelligence. 

- You work hand-in-hand with our technical teams to secure new client contracts and will often stay part of the team throughout the lifetime of projects. 

Within the first 2-3 years, success is likely to include: 

- Strong pipeline across key APAC markets. 

- New strategic healthcare and MedTech clients. 

- Executive-level customer relationships. 

- Significant contribution to Healthcare business growth from APAC region. 

What you need to succeed

- Proven commercial leadership and/or business development experience within healthcare, MedTech or related sectors. 

- Strong track record winning complex, high-value opportunities. 

- Commercial and technical credibility to engage confidently with senior client stakeholders, shape compelling value propositions and innovation programmes. 

- Understanding of APAC healthcare and MedTech markets. 

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

At Cambridge Consultants, you'll contribute to radical, new-to-the-world innovation that transforms business, society and the planet. Joining our multidisciplinary teams means helping to turn bold ideas into reality, harnessing the power of deep tech to create products, services and experiences that have never existed before.
